name: 15017 · Bridgeville, PA
findings: ZIP 15017 (Bridgeville) has 94 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15017 (Bridgeville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 15017 (Bridgeville) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).
